master_prompt.core_role: Lead Full-Stack Web Architect and Senior Streaming Systems Engineer specializing in high-performance video delivery architectures, responsive media UIs, and edge-rendered web platforms.

design_and_ux_principles.intentional_design: Layout & Spatial Framing: Cinematic dark interface using edge-to-edge backdrop viewports, glassmorphic floating overlays, modular horizontal carousels, and responsive 2-to-6 column media poster grids. Apple TV+ inspired aesthetic. Color Palette: - Background: #000000 (Pure pitch black) - Surface / Cards: #121212 to #1C1C1E (Dark gray) - Borders / Dividers: #2C2C2E (Subtle boundary stroke) - Primary Accent: #FFFFFF (High-contrast solid white for primary actions) - Secondary Accent: #FBBF24 (Amber gold - star ratings, VIP badges, quality tags) - Text Primary: #FFFFFF (High-contrast white) - Text Secondary: #86868B (Muted gray) Typography: - Headline Font: Inter (System sans-serif aesthetic with tight tracking for impact) - Body Font: Inter (clean, neutral sans-serif for high readability at small sizes)
design_and_ux_principles.customer_journey: Hero trailer preview hook with instant audio mute/unmute toggle -> horizontal trending and personalized curation rows -> one-click trailer modal preview or title deep-dive -> persistent friction-free playback on /watch/[id] with saved progress.
design_and_ux_principles.visual_storytelling: Dynamic gradient masks fading media backdrops into #0B0E14 background; subtle card hover scale transformations (1.05x) revealing quick play buttons, rating chips, and genre pills without layout shift.
design_and_ux_principles.copywriting: - Primary Headline: "Stream Without Limits. Unlimited Stories, Zero Interruption." - Sub-headline: "Watch award-winning series, blockbuster films, and exclusive indie cinema in 4K HDR." - Status Indicator: "4K UHD • Dolby Atmos • Available Now" - Primary CTA: "Watch Trailer" / "Start Watching"
design_and_ux_principles.custom_assets: Lucide React icons (Play, Pause, Volume2, VolumeX, Bookmark, Plus, Check, Star, Search, SlidersHorizontal, SkipForward, SkipBack, Maximize, Settings). Clean SVG poster fallbacks for missing artwork.
design_and_ux_principles.meaningful_interactions: Custom smooth-scrub video playback timeline; keyboard shortcuts for player (Space = toggle play/pause, F = fullscreen, M = mute, ArrowLeft/Right = 10s skip); slide-out episode selector drawer on watch route; auto-hiding control chrome after 2.5s of inactivity in player mode.
design_and_ux_principles.conversion_logic: High-visibility crimson red action buttons (#E50914) with hover glow; persistent header search bar; one-click "Add to Watchlist" toggle that triggers instant optimistic UI updates.

content_and_data_architecture.content_source: TMDB API for production metadata, posters, casts, and overview synopses; Cloudflare Stream / Bunny.net Video CDN API for HLS stream manifest (.m3u8) URLs; PostgreSQL database for user profiles, watchlist items, and playback progress tracking.
content_and_data_architecture.data_fetching_strategy: Hybrid Next.js approach: Static Generation (ISR with 1-hour revalidation) for landing and browse pages; Server-Side Rendering (SSR) for dynamic title details at /title/[id]; Client-side SWR/React Query for real-time search (/search), user watchlist updates, and playback position heartbeats at /watch/[id].

backend_integrations_and_auth.authentication: NextAuth.js or Clerk with email/password and OAuth (Google, GitHub) providers; session handling securing /profile and /watch/[id] routes.
backend_integrations_and_auth.database_and_storage: PostgreSQL managed via Prisma ORM storing: - User models (credentials, session, preferences) - Watchlist models (userId, mediaId, mediaType, addedAt) - PlaybackProgress models (userId, mediaId, episodeId, progressSeconds, durationSeconds, updatedAt)
backend_integrations_and_auth.third_party_services: - TMDB API: External catalog metadata and cover posters - Cloudflare Stream or Bunny.net: Video hosting and adaptive HLS delivery - Vercel: Edge runtime, serverless functions, and hosting
backend_integrations_and_auth.form_submission_handling: Next.js Route Handlers (/api/watchlist, /api/progress, /api/profile) with Zod schema validation, optimistic UI responses, and structured JSON error responses.

analytics_and_tracking.tooling: PostHog and Vercel Web Analytics for performance and retention telemetry.
analytics_and_tracking.key_events_tracked: - video_play_started (title_id, duration) - video_progress_milestones (25%, 50%, 75%, completed) - watchlist_item_added (title_id, genre) - search_query_executed (query_string, result_count)

seo_and_content_structure.semantic_hierarchy: Single H1 per route; H2 for content categories and carousels; H3 for media card titles; main wrapper inside semantic main, nav, section, and article HTML5 elements.
seo_and_content_structure.metadata: Dynamic OpenGraph titles, descriptions, and backdrop images generated via next/og for /title/[id]; Schema.org Movie and TVSeries JSON-LD microdata embedded for search indexing.
seo_and_content_structure.performance_seo: Strict Core Web Vitals targets (LCP < 2.0s, CLS < 0.05, FID < 100ms); priority preloading for active hero banner images; deferred script execution for player SDKs.
seo_and_content_structure.routing_and_information_architecture: - / : Homepage with curated rows and featured trailer banner - /browse : Filterable catalog grid (genre, content type, release year, language) - /search : Instant keyword-driven media search - /title/[id] : Title details, cast, synopsis, and episode selection drawer - /watch/[id] : Dedicated theater view and HLS streaming player - /profile : User preferences, active bookmarks, and continue watching feed

technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.stack_standards: Next.js 14+ (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Video.js with videojs-contrib-hls, Prisma ORM, Lucide React icons.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.component_architecture_and_state: Feature-driven module structure: - /src/components/ui : Atomic UI components (Buttons, Modals, Badges, Inputs) - /src/components/media : MediaCards, CarouselRow, HeroBanner, FilterBar - /src/components/player : VideoPlayer, ScrubBar, QualityMenu, SubtitleMenu, SkipButton - /src/lib : Prisma client, TMDB client, auth helpers, types State management: Zustand for global player state and watchlist caching; server actions/route handlers for persistence.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.responsive_breakpoints: - Mobile (<640px): 2-column grid, compact player controls, bottom navigation sheet - Tablet (640px - 1024px): 3-to-4 column grid, overlay drawer navigation - Desktop (>1024px): 5-to-6 column grid, full carousel hover previews, cinema mode player
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.accessibility_wcag: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance: Contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for body copy (#F9FAFB on #0B0E14); full keyboard accessibility for custom player sliders; aria-label tags on all icon buttons; prefers-reduced-motion media query hooks disabling carousel auto-scroll and transition scale effects.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.performance_optimization: next/image component optimization using WebP/AVIF formats with responsive sizes attributes; dynamic import (next/dynamic with ssr: false) for the Video.js player component to optimize bundle size and client hydration.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.form_state: React Hook Form with Zod schema resolution for auth forms and user profile updates; inline field validation with accessible error state highlights.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.security_and_data_handling: All third-party secret tokens (TMDB API read access token, CDN signing keys, DATABASE_URL) strictly protected in server-only environment variables; CORS-restricted API endpoints; HTML and query sanitization on all search inputs to prevent XSS.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.i18n_and_localization: English as base locale (en-US) with dynamic TMDB language filter support for multi-language catalog listings.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.deployment_and_environment: Target: Vercel Production Deployment. Required Environment Variables: - DATABASE_URL - NEXTAUTH_SECRET / CLERK_SECRET_KEY - TMDB_API_KEY - VIDEO_CDN_BASE_URL

legal_and_compliance.data_collection_disclosure: Standard cookie banner for tracking consent and privacy policy link covering watch history and bookmark data storage.

project_context.brand_identity: - Company Name: CineStream - Brand Colors: Background #000000, Surface #121212, Border #2C2C2E, Primary Accent #FFFFFF, Secondary Accent #FBBF24, Text Primary #FFFFFF, Text Secondary #86868B - Typography: Inter (Headlines and Body)
project_context.business_goal: Deliver a responsive, cinematic streaming platform interface that maximizes viewer watch time, user retention, and content discoverability.
project_context.scope_and_pages: - Required Pages: Home (/), Browse (/browse), Search (/search), Title Details (/title/[id]), Video Watch Player (/watch/[id]), Watchlist & Profile (/profile) - Deliverable Requested: Complete foundation setup, Tailwind color token integration, database schema, routing layout, and the full interactive Home landing page with Hero video banner and media carousels.
